name: query_gwas_catalog
description: Get GWAS associations from NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog for a gene or trait including trait associations and p-values
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_gwas_catalog; result = query_gwas_catalog('APOE', p_value_threshold=5e-8)

parameters.gene_or_trait: str — gene symbol or trait keyword (e.g. 'APOE', 'obesity', 'aging')

returns: dict with keys: gene, associations (list of {trait, snp_id, p_value, or_beta, mapped_gene}), n_associations, source
